text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, it looks like you're almost out of stamina, aren't you?
You can't get any closer like this~

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me. I shall recover swiftly!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, this is a bit rough, honestly.
There's no opening to use magic at all, I'm tellin' ya.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Hah! Here's a protective shield!
Quickly, cast your ultimate magic while you still can!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nice one, Desire-chan!
Alright, let's finish this in one go, Accu-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty. Here goes nothing~.
Heeave!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent victory.
Seeing how in sync the two of you were,
I found myself completely mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's all thanks to Desire-chan's support.
As expected of our Saint, you really keep a close eye on everything♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"—This was a scene from lunchtime.
I did receive words of praise, indeed,
but is it truly right to be satisfied with just this?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If my healing and support had been swifter and more precise, both of you would surely have had an easier time fighting.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Becoming strong enough to clear quests even as a solitary Saint. Do that, and you will surely be able to grant absolute divine protection."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we begin our training?
So that I can remain a holy maiden even inside the game!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, that one hit took out so much HP...!
Even if I'm not a frontline character, I need to get better at judging recovery windows.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so tough... Even with an attack boost,
I'm barely dealing any damage.
I'd better upgrade my gear first.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...No, no matter how many times I try, I can't win...
Was a lone Saint's battle reckless after all?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "...No. I have overcome far harsher trials before this. Giving up is simply not an option."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I can't expect the character to get any stronger.
In that case... I have to become stronger myself.
Yes—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I can read the enemy's movements and not take
a single blow, I'll be fine. Even if it takes time,
as long as I steadily push forward, a path will surely open!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin once more.
Focus even harder, keep your mind racing,
and stand up as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of repeated training to assess the battle situation,
her positioning and situational judgment during races
began to steadily improve.
